title: This ESP32 Antenna Array Can See WiFi
summary: The creator of ESPARGOS, an ESP32-based antenna array from the University of Stuttgart, explains how it senses phase and amplitude of WiFi signals to localize devices and build a WiFi camera. It demos the Python library and project.
why: Recommended as the companion explanation to the Espargos project, showing how phase and time differences localize devices.
